svg.text: Layout B · mixed: counts on PRs and Issues, a dot on Activity, quiet totals in headers
Round 1, greyscale. Phone 412x915, synthetic data only. Issue #38: quieter tab badges. 99+ cap, no badge at 0, the full total moves into each header.
1 · PRs tab, 3 need you
2 · Issues tab, today's 153 becomes 3
3 · Activity tab
Badge 3 = 2 unseen in Needs my review + 1 updated PR of yours (Mine).
Today it reads 12: every unseen PR, Org open and Dependabot included.
Org open #22 is NEW but does not count: nobody asked you.
Header: 14 open, 13px muted after the title. The full number lives here, not
on the tab.
Badge 3 = unseen in In progress, Assigned to me or Mentioned. Today it
reads 153 because All open counts every unseen issue.
All open stays a section; its unseen rows keep their dot and pill but leave the
badge.
Header: 153 open. The old number is still one glance away, on the screen it
describes.
Dot = at least one unseen item with a needsMe event (#372 review request,
#398 mention).
Why a dot: Activity re-announces items already counted on PRs and Issues.
A second number would count #372 twice. The dot says look, not how many.
Header: 18 new, every unseen event including CI and merges.
4 · Every badge state at 2x · Issues tab icon, then Activity for the dot
Issues
Zero
No badge.
aria-label="Issues"
Issues
1 to 9
18 x 18 circle.
aria-label="Issues, 3 need you"
Issues
23 x 18 pill.
aria-label="Issues, 42 need you"
Issues
30 x 18 pill, the widest. 100 and up all read
aria-label="Issues, more than 99 need you"
Activity
Dot
8px dot, 2px ring. Activity only.
aria-label="Activity, new items need you"

Geometry at 1x: 18px tall, 5px side padding, 12px bold, min width 18. Left edge fixed at icon centre + 4px, so the badge grows right into the empty tab slot instead of left over the icon (today it is pinned right: 6px and grows left).

Accessible name moves to the tab button and the badge is aria-hidden. Today the badge span carries aria-label="N unseen", which screen readers often skip on a plain span, and the visible text "153" runs into the label as "PRs 153".
Labels drawn at 13px, the intended .ph-tab size. Shape carries state: a filled badge or dot, never colour alone.
5 · Inventory · today on main (read from web/phone/ and shared/)
How each badge is computed today
PRs (PhoneApp.tsx, unseen.prs): every PR with seen != 'seen' and not opened this session (seenLocal). All sections
count, Org open and Dependabot included.
Issues (unseen.issues): every issue with seen != 'seen' and not in issueSeen. All open holds every issue, so the
badge reaches 153.
Activity (activityBadge in shared/activity.ts): item groups with any event by someone else newer than lastVisit. Filter is
'all', so CI and merges count.
Render (PhoneBars.tsx, TabBar): shows n when n > 0, no cap. Span aria-label "N unseen". .ph-count pinned right:
6px.
Bug: tab labels render at 15px
.ph-tab sets 13px / 18px, but .phone button { font: inherit } (0,1,1) beats .ph-tab (0,1,0), so labels take 15px / 22px
from .phone.
Fix as #33 did for headers (.phone .ph-section): select .phone .ph-tab (0,2,0) in phone-shell.css. Bold on the active
tab already works, since .ph-tab.is-active is (0,2,0).
Every frame on this board draws labels at 13px.
Needs-you and unseen signals in the data
seen: 'new' | 'updated' | 'seen' on every PR and issue (shared/types.ts). Drives the NEW and UPDATED pills.
seenLocal and issueSeen: cleared when an item's sheet closes, before the server catches up.
Review requested: sectionsFor() puts a PR in 'needs' when you or one of your teams is requested
(shared/sections.ts).
Yours: 'mine' section, PR author is you.
Assigned: issue.assignees includes you ('assigned' and 'progress' sections).
Mentioned: issue 'mentioned' section; activity event kind 'mention'.
needsMe: boolean on every activity event (activity-types.ts), used by the Needs filter.
Activity unseen: event.at newer than lastVisit. No per-item seen state.
What changes in layout B
PRs: unseen and in Needs my review or Mine. 12 becomes 3.
Issues: unseen and in In progress, Assigned to me or Mentioned. 153 becomes 3.
Activity: a dot when any unseen group has a needsMe event. No number.
Headers: quiet total after the title (14 open, 153 open, 18 new), 13px muted. Counts already exist (section rows,
view.unseen).
All tabs: 99+ cap, badge grows right, aria-label on the button. No new server data.
Open question
Should an updated PR in Mine count? Here it does, since a review on your PR usually needs a reply.
